predecessors.name: Federal Republic of Somalia
predecessors.text: the former British Somaliland, which 'obtained independence as the State of Somaliland' on 26 June 1960 and 'united as planned to form the Somali Republic' on 1 July 1960

ledger.x: 1991 (18 May): the Somaliland north declares independence from Somalia.
1998: Puntland is founded and disputes Sool and Sanaag.
2023: Somaliland loses Las Anod and the east.

wars.name: Las Anod conflict
wars.outcome: SSC-Khatumo took Las Anod and most of its claimed area from Somaliland in 2023; 'a military stalemate presently holds' with the front 'about 100km away from the city of Las Anod' as of August 2024.

wars.name: Sool and Sanaag dispute with Puntland
wars.outcome: Somaliland took Las Anod in October 2007; the Dhulbahante were 'torn between' Somaliland, Puntland and an independent entity, and the Khatumo State of Somalia was declared on 12 January 2012.

certainty.note: De facto borders: the line with Somalia and Puntland is a front, not a treaty, and the colonial limits with Ethiopia and Djibouti are not on any page opened.
